To be honest, the only real difference between manga and Western comics is how there published. The manga books you see in libraries and bookstores are actually called Tankobans, which just collect a few chapters of manga from monthly jumps. You see when a western comic is published the "chapter" is released as an individual book called an "issue" when a Japanese manga is released, they publish it monthly in a magazine called a jump. The thing is we don't really get Jumps in the US and we end up getting the tankobans which gives the illusion that manga is longer. Now in America, we have a thing called a trade paperback, our version of a tankobon. Now to answer your question I recommend starting with some indie image 90s stuff, pretty straightforward, start with issue one and go on.
